text:
hana: hi all — quick onboarding Q. I keep getting a few different bot DMs (checklist, health survey, office wifi tips). where's the canonical place to tweak these? also my VPN fails when opening the internal slack links.
miguel (people-ops): hey hana, welcome! :wave: For bot prefs open the DM with @onboard-bot -> top-right -> Preferences. You can set frequency or opt out. We send the checklist and the weekly survey by default for the first 30 days.
hana: i only see "mute" and "more" in the DM header, not preferences. is that an org-level config?
lee (it): if you click the bot name -> View app -> there's a "Settings" link. From there you can toggle notifications. If you still don't see it, tell me your OS and slack client (desktop/web).
hana: macOS 13, slack desktop 4.30.0.
lee (it): cool. if the app version is old, update Slack first. for the VPN/link problem: what's the exact error when opening https://intra.redwood from slack? does it open in browser or show a TLS error?
hana: opens in browser then the page is a blank white page. debug console shows 403 forbidden.
tara (eng): 403 could mean missing SSO header or not on the VPN/proxy. @lee — might be an edge case with our forwarding proxy for macs.
lee (it): @hana try this quick check: open an incognito/private window and paste the link. if it still 403, run `curl -I https://intra.redwood` and paste headers. also confirm you're in the org SSO (chrome signed into SSO).
miguel (people-ops): short rule for everyone here: Where to ask — access or infra blockers -> #eng-infra or DM the oncall (tag is in channel header). Role/process/onboarding -> #new-hires or people-ops DMs. Product questions -> your team channel or #product.
hana: ok will try curl. quick question re: public channels vs team channels—where should I post general onboarding questions so new folks see answers?
tara (eng): post general onboarding/process Qs in #new-hires (helps future hires). Team-specific or ticket-level issues go to your team channel. If it's infra and might need escalation, post in #eng-infra and mark with :exclamation:.
hanna: thanks! also can i snooze checklist reminders for the first week? the bot pings at 9am and interrupts deep work.
onboard-bot: Tip: send `snooze 7d` to this bot to pause reminders for 7 days. Send `snooze 1h` to pause temporarily.
hana: perfect — snoozed. thanks.
lee (it): followed up and refreshed your VPN cert. try reconnecting and let us know. if issues persist DM with screenshots.
miguel (people-ops): FYI we added a short note to the onboarding guide about bot control + which channels to use. link: https://intra.redwood/onboarding/channels (will update later today).
hana: reconnected! access to intra working now. appreciate the quick help. see you all at the 2pm intro.
